salary_components.title: Salary Components (From Form 16)
salary_components.description: Components of salary as mentioned in Form 16
salary_components.note: Form 16 Part A contains all these details

tds_details.title: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
tds_details.description: TDS deducted by employer on salary
tds_details.note: Form 16 Part B shows month-wise TDS breakdown

standard_deduction.title: Standard Deduction
standard_deduction.description: Fixed deduction available to salaried employees

HRA.title: Section 10(13A) - House Rent Allowance
HRA.calculation: Minimum of: (1) Actual HRA received, (2) Actual rent paid - 10% of basic salary, (3) 50% of basic (metro) or 40% (non-metro)
requirements: PAN of landlord (if rent > ₹1,00,000 per annum)

80C.title: Section 80C - Deduction for investments
80C.description: Deduction up to ₹1,50,000 for investments in specified instruments
eligible_investments: Stamp duty and registration fees for property
80C.form16_display: Claimed in Annexure - Schedule (as per Form 16 Part A)

80D.title: Section 80D - Health Insurance Premium
80D.description: Deduction for health insurance premium paid

80CCD_1.title: Section 80CCD(1) - Employee Contribution to NPS
80CCD_1.description: Contribution to National Pension System (Employee contribution)

limits.note: Up to 10% of salary or ₹1.5 Lakh under Section 80C (whichever is lower)

80CCD_1.form16_display: Shown as Part of Section 80C limit

80CCD_1B.title: Section 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS Contribution
80CCD_1B.description: Additional deduction for NPS contribution (over and above Section 80C)

80E.title: Section 80E - Education Loan Interest
80E.description: Deduction for interest paid on education loan
80E.note: Entire amount of interest paid (no upper limit)
eligible: Loan taken from bank or approved financial institution

80G.title: Section 80G - Charitable Donations
80G.description: Deduction for donations to approved charities
80G.note: 50% or 100% deduction depending on charity type

80TTA.title: Section 80TTA - Savings Account Interest
80TTA.description: Deduction for interest from savings account
eligible: Individual having savings account with bank/post office

80TTB.title: Section 80TTB - Senior Citizen Interest Income
80TTB.description: Deduction for interest income for senior citizens (60+ years)
eligible: Resident individual aged 60 years or above
Income from deposits in bank/financial institution

24B.title: Section 24B - Home Loan Interest
24B.description: Deduction for interest on home loan
24B.note: ₹2,00,000 for self-occupied property or ₹30,000 for let-out property
eligible: Interest on loan taken for acquiring/constructing property

80GG.title: Section 80GG - Rent Paid (Without HRA)
80GG.description: Deduction for rent paid when not receiving HRA
80GG.calculation: Lowest of: (1) Rent paid - 10% of total income, (2) 25% of total income, (3) ₹5,000 per month

old.description: Old Tax Regime with full deductions (FY 2023-24)
old.description_detailed: All Section 80 deductions are allowed. Best for those with significant deductions.

new.description: New Tax Regime with lower rates (FY 2023-24)
new.description_detailed: No Section 80 deductions allowed. Only standard deduction. Best for those with minimal deductions.

form16_information.full_name: Certificate of Tax Deducted at Source
form16_information.validity: Issued by employer to employee for salary income
form16_information.issued_date: Before May 31st of the following financial year

parts.part_a: Details of salary, TDS deductions, and deductions claimed

form16_information.use: Required for filing Income Tax Return (ITR)

tips: Form 16 contains all details needed for ITR filing
Compare Old vs New regime using your Form 16 data
Health insurance premium should be paid before the financial year ends
Keep proper documentation for all deductions claimed in Form 16
Review your regime choice annually based on your total deductions
NPS contribution under 80CCD(1B) is in addition to 80C limit
HRA exemption requires rent receipts and rental agreement
Home loan interest deduction requires Form 12BA from lender
First-time homebuyers can claim additional deduction under 80EE
If no HRA provided, claim rent deduction under Section 80GG
Education loan interest deduction has no upper limit under 80E
